title: 第13章 她亲手撕开第一张脸
lines: 是那种——人心开始裂开的乱。
春杏的尸体还停在偏院。
下人更是连路过都要绕远三尺。
因为所有人都开始怀疑一件事——
相爷一夜未眠，眼下乌青。
苏柔站在一旁，指尖发抖。
昨天那一局之后，所有人都清楚一件事——
苏晚，不再是“可以随叫随到的人”。
她是“会让局反过来的人”。
最终，还是苏晚自己来了。
她走进正厅的时候，所有人都下意识安静了一瞬。
平静得像昨夜那场风暴与她无关。
content_zh:
镇北王醒来的消息，像一把刀，插进了京城的平静里。

    有人松了一口气。

    有人却开始发抖。

    因为所有人都知道——

    能把“必死之人”从阎王手里拽回来的人，从来不是善类。

    镇北王府，夜深。

    风从檐下穿过，带着血腥味未散的冷意。

    内殿灯火未熄。

    镇北王坐在榻上，胸口的伤已经被重新处理过，但气息仍旧虚浮。

    他盯着窗外。

    像在看一盘看不见的棋。

    脚步声响起。

    他没有回头。

    “你来了。”

    苏晚走进来。

    依旧是那身素衣。

    平静得像什么都没发生过。

    她看了一眼他的伤口。

    “恢复得比预想快。”

    镇北王低声笑了一下。

    “你下手很稳。”

    苏晚点头。

    “因为你命很贵。”

    一句话，让空气顿了一瞬。

    镇北王抬眼看她。

    “贵？”

    苏晚轻声：

    “你的命，是用来试东西的。”

    镇北王眉头微动。

    “试什么？”

    苏晚没有立刻回答。

    她走到桌前，倒了一杯冷茶。

    指尖轻轻敲了一下杯沿。

    “试一件事。”

    她抬眼。

    “这张网，到底铺到哪里了。”

    镇北王沉默了一瞬。

    “你已经确定有网了。”

    苏晚点头。

    “不是怀疑。”

    “是确认。”

    她看着他。

    “你只是其中一根线。”

    镇北王眼神微沉。

    “所以那天，我是被‘导流’的那一个？”

    苏晚轻声：

    “是。”

    屋内安静下来。

    镇北王盯着她。

    忽然问：

    “你救我，不是因为我是镇北王？”

    苏晚摇头。

    “不是。”

    镇北王又问：

    “那是为什么？”

    苏晚停了一瞬。

    “因为你还能说话。”

    这句话很轻。

    却让镇北王心口一沉。

    他忽然笑了一声。

    “你说话真不像个医者。”

    苏晚看他。

    “那像什么？”

    镇北王盯着她。

    “像在挑选刀的人。”

    空气安静了一瞬。

    苏晚没有否认。

    镇北王缓缓靠在榻上。

    声音低了些：

    “你现在很危险。”
content_en:
The sky in the capital is not yet bright.

    There was chaos outside the palace gate.

    Not ordinary chaos.

    It's the kind of chaos where the imperial army blocks the road, the imperial doctor is summoned urgently, and the servants are running around.

    The sound of horse hooves hit the bluestone road one after another.

    It was as if someone was timing "someone" with the rhythm of the entire capital.

    "Something happened to King Zhenbei!"

    A word came from the palace.

    The tranquility of the morning was instantly crushed.

    Side hall.

    Su Wan just closed the needle.

    The "drug tester" last night has been transferred away.

    There is still a bit of blood and medicine mixed in the air.

    When the chamberlain rushed in, he almost stumbled in.

    "Miss Su!"

    "Your Majesty calls urgently!"

    "King Zhenbei... is seriously injured and on the verge of death!"

    Su Wan made a move.

    Didn't ask why.

    Just look up.

    "Lead the way."

    Two words.

    Clean and crisp.

    Zhenbei Palace.

    The door has been sealed.

    Three layers of forbidden troops surrounded it.

    The atmosphere was oppressive.

    Everyone knows——

    If this person dies, the capital will change.

    It’s not a “wind change”.

    It’s a “pattern change.”

    When Su Wan was brought into the inner hall, there were already people kneeling in the room.

    Imperial physician.

    Guards.

    There were even chamberlains around the emperor.

    Everyone looked extremely ugly.

    On the bed.

    The king of Zhenbei was lying down.

    The black armor is still on.

    A penetrating wound to the chest.

    The bleeding couldn't stop.

    The most fatal thing is not trauma.

    But - the breath is disappearing little by little.

    The imperial doctor knelt on the ground, his voice trembling:

    "Return to Your Majesty... more than half of the heart vessels are damaged..."

    "The sea of ​​qi collapsed..."

    "At most...one stick of incense..."

    The emperor stood aside, his face extremely gloomy.

    No words were spoken.

    But that silence is scarier than any anger.

    Su Wan walked in.

    Everyone subconsciously stepped aside.

    Not because of orders.

    It's because of the "sense of certainty" in her.

    As long as she stood there, there was still a "possibility" that the matter would be solved.

    She walked to the bed.

    Lower your head.

    Take a look.

    Then he spoke:

    "It can be saved."

    The imperial doctor suddenly raised his head:

    "Nonsense!"

    "This injury has destroyed the soul!"

    Su Wan didn't look at him.

    Just reach out.

    Press it on the chest of King Zhenbei.

    Three breaths.

    Stop.

    She raised her eyes.

    "It's not trauma."

    One sentence.

    Let the room become silent for a moment.

    The emperor finally spoke.

    Deep voice:

    "What do you mean?"

    Su Wan whispered:

    "The knife is just the entrance."

    "The real problem is inside."

    She paused.

    "He was given a 'pulse locking technique'."

    The imperial doctor's expression changed:

    "That's a forbidden technique!"
title_en: Chapter 12 The harder the concubine cries, the more flaws there are
